transcript: The human brain weighs about 1.3 kilograms, though only a tiny part of the body and weight inside it lies a network of 86 billion neurons. Each neuron is linked with thousands of others through synapses. In the whole brain, around 100 trillion synapses form a net like network. Memory, perception, emotion, judgment. Everything we call self arises from this complex neural activity.
